about_the_game:
The legendary heroes have returned! Merlin Survivors is a fast-paced and challenging roguelike survival game. Take control of legendary heroes like Merlin, Arthur, Lancelot, and Morgana, and fight against relentless waves of enemies.

Each character has unique abilities and fighting styles. As enemies grow tougher, your reflexes and strategic decisions will determine your survival. Develop yourself on the battlefield and make crucial choices.

Strengthen your heroes with the resources you collect, unlock new abilities, and customize your playstyle. Thanks to procedurally generated levels, every run offers a different experience, enhancing replayability.

Merlin Survivors delivers an exciting, challenging, and ever-changing adventure for action and roguelike fans.

Are you ready? The battle begins!
